title: Students with Discipline
description: Students with Discipline - Run this query to find students that have had a discipline record for the current school year. Change XX to the school and change the 07/01/2021 to the first day of school
code: LIST STU DIS DIS.SN STU.LN STU.FN STU.GR DIS.DT DIS.CD DIS.CD? DIS.SCL DIS.SID DIS.UN IF DIS.SCL = XX AND DIS.DT > 07/01/2021
